serverInfo.title: CatchDoms MCP Server
serverInfo.description: Search expired, auction, brandable, aged deleted, and pending-delete domains from 20+ sources with SEO metrics, quality scores, traffic estimates, and auction prices.

auth.description: Pro subscription required. Tokens are issued at /api-access.

transports.description: Free tier: top 50 domains, masked names.

tools.name: search_domains
tools.description: Search domains with 20+ filters (source, TLD, score, age, backlinks, DA, language, keywords, tech stack, traffic, created_after/added_on), explicit sort (score, traffic, snapshots, TF, RD, DA, age, created_at), pagination (page × limit ≤ 2,000) and a compact response shape (fields=compact).

tools.name: search_pending_delete_domains
tools.description: Authority+ — search actionable pending-delete ccTLD and gTLD inventory by TLD, status, source, drop window, and snapshot week.

tools.name: get_domain
tools.description: Get details for a specific domain by ID or name.

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: Available filter options (sources, TLDs, languages with counts).
